item.title: New Site Update!
item.description: I talk about the new site overhaul into HTML using Hugo!

item.title: Little Ashton - House Generator
item.description: This post follows the development of a dynamic building generator using Houdini, inspired by Exp33 and Atomfall.

item.title: Texture Utility Tool - PyQt
item.description: This post is about a Python based texture utility tool that can rescale, convert file types, pack and split channels of texture maps.

item.title: Sky Island Generator
item.description: This post is about the creation of a sky island generator in Houdini inspired by the Legend of Zelda Tears of the Kingdom

item.title: Dungeon Delve Project
item.description: This post is about a quick diorama project that sets up modular kits, animated portal effects and post process in Unreal Engine.

item.title: Robot Dog Project
item.description: This post documents the retoplogy, rigging, skinning and shader work for creating a game ready animated robot dog.

item.title: Outsource Asset Validator for UE
item.description: This post documents the creation of a asset manager that bakes, validates and imports outsourced meshes with shaders setup into Unreal Engine.

item.title: Winter Shader Musuem
item.description: This project showcases a variety of winter shaders for Unreal Engine 5.

item.title: Panopto Caption Translator with Python
item.description: Easily and qucikly translate captions from videos (Panopto) using Python

item.title: PCG Scatter Tool Breakdown
item.description: This post documents building a PCG scattering tool for foliage and repetitive assets.

item.title: Convert Images w/Python Script
item.description: This post documents a older image converter I created using Python and TKinter.

item.title: Pipe Generator Tool
item.description: This post follows the development of a procedural copper pipe tool using Houdini for Unreal Engine.

item.title: Maxscript May Development Journal
item.description: This post follows the development of various utility scripts using the Maxscript language during May 2025.
